name: apple-tv-remote
title: Apple TV Remote
description: Control your Apple TV using pyatv
author: marcjulian

preferences.name: condaEnvironment
preferences.title: Conda Environment
preferences.description: Name of the conda environment where pyatv is installed (e.g., 'pyatv-env'). Leave empty to use system Python.

preferences.name: condaPath
preferences.title: Conda Path
preferences.description: Custom path to conda executable (optional). Defaults to 'conda' in PATH.

commands.name: control-apple-tv
commands.title: Control Apple TV
commands.subtitle: Remote Control
commands.description: Send remote control commands to your Apple TV

commands.name: scan-devices
commands.title: Scan for Apple TV Devices
commands.subtitle: Device Discovery
commands.description: Scan your network for Apple TV devices

commands.name: pair-device
commands.title: Pair with Apple TV
commands.subtitle: Device Setup
commands.description: Pair with an Apple TV device for control

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing on Apple TV
commands.subtitle: Playback Info
commands.description: View what's currently playing on your Apple TV

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
